title: The Secret of the Underwater Kingdom
synopsis: Moonia's moon pendant shows a map of the sea, and a magic bubble carries Lumi, Bobo and Draco down to the Underwater Kingdom. Its guardian, the little mermaid Coralie, says the Ocean Pearl is missing and the kingdom is losing its colors; the friends find it trapped in a giant bubble by a cave, and the pendant's matching moon symbol frees it, so a wave of color sweeps through the sea. Helping others makes the world more beautiful.
ending: Coralie gives Lumi a tiny glowing seashell, and it projects a mysterious snowy mountain. Their next adventure waits in a world of snow and ice.
newCharacters: Coralie, the little mermaid guardian of the Underwater Kingdom: turquoise-and-aqua tail, long flowing ocean-blue hair, little fin-shaped ears, a sea-green top, a pearl belt and a sparkling pink seashell hair clip (Coralie in src/ep06/props.tsx)
